summary:
Iteration 18 — verified BOTH fixes from iteration 17 report. (1) Agent quota REFUND on failure works: HTTP-level test confirms an empty selected_text raises ValueError inside run_inline_command and the /api/ai/agent/command endpoint 400s WITHOUT charging the free-tier counter (quota remaining stays at 5/5). A second HTTP test confirms empty instruction (whitespace-only) also refunds. A direct unit test against Mongo proves the refund_charge() helper correctly decrements the agent_usage counter, honours the count>0 guard (no negatives), and is a no-op for subscribers. A happy-path HTTP test confirms the counter still decrements on success (5→4). The generic-Exception branch on /api/ai/agent/chat and /api/ai/agent/command uses the exact same refund helper as the ValueError branch (verified by code review of server.py lines 1904-1911 and 2019-2030) so refund behaviour is guaranteed on any downstream LLM failure. (2) Dashboard HTML strip works: registered a fresh user, POSTed a document with content '

Chapter One

The wind picked up.

', loaded /dashboard, and asserted the preview text is exactly 'Chapter One The wind picked up.' with NO '<' or '>' characters. Regression: full 34-test test_billing.py suite + full 37-test test_iter17_audit.py suite still pass (71/71 GREEN).
backend_tests_run: 4/4 PASSED in tests/test_iter18_quota_refund.py (HTTP+direct-helper). 71/71 PASSED regression (34 billing + 37 iter17 audit).
critical_code_review_comments: In-process TestClient monkeypatching of writing_agent.agent_chat / run_inline_command was attempted but failed because motor's AsyncIOMotorClient is bound to the supervisor's event loop and can't be reused across a fresh pytest loop (RuntimeError: Event loop is closed). Not a bug in the app — a limitation of the current test harness. The ValueError branch of the refund + a direct helper unit test cover the behaviour end-to-end. If the main agent wants full HTTP coverage of the 502 branch, either (a) run the test in the same process as the FastAPI app using pytest-asyncio + httpx.ASGITransport with a per-test motor client, or (b) add a feature-flagged debug endpoint /api/ai/agent/_force_fail that raises inside the same try/except and remove it before ship.
server.py is still 2994 lines — carrying forward iteration 17's recommendation to split into routers/{agent,billing,audiobook}.py. Not blocking this ship.
test_credentials: Privileged credentials removed after security rotation. Iter18 tests register fresh test_iter18_*@example.com users on the fly.
seed_data_creation: Per-run: ~5 fresh test_iter18_* users, 1 document per user, and 1 direct TEST_iter18_refund_* agent_usage row that is deleted in the test's finally block.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The refund helper /app/backend/agent_quota.py::refund_charge() has been unit-tested directly against Mongo and via HTTP through the ValueError branch of /api/ai/agent/command. The generic Exception branch of both /agent/chat and /agent/command call the exact same helper (verified via code review) — if a future change diverges these two branches, add HTTP tests using an in-process ASGI transport with a fresh motor client per test. The Dashboard preview strip is a plain regex in Dashboard.js line 413: `.replace(/<[^>]+>/g, ' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, 200)` — sufficient for MVP but a malformed tag like '<script>' with no closing '>' would still leak; consider DOMPurify if this is ever fed user-supplied HTML from untrusted sources (currently only own-user content).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — both iteration-17 fixes verified working.
